answer: Proof of Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism in AI networks by requiring capital commitment to validate transactions. An attacker reaching the nadir of protocol security must acquire a majority of native tokens, turning the network into a haven for honest actors. While a rogue entity might attempt to bend the consensus like a willow, the prohibitive economic cost of purchasing sufficient stake renders the attack vector prohibitively expensive and inherently self-defeating for the adversary.
